name: Survive nightmare XChristianXsj
desc:
Are you ready to face the ultimate test of courage? Brace yourself for heart-pounding excitement and adrenaline-fueled pursuits as you navigate the eerie, dark depths of an ancient dungeon. Can you outmaneuver the terrifying black monster with its long neck, glowing white eyes, and extended arms? 
Controls:

PC: Sprint: Hold LeftShift (while moving)

Xbox/PlayStation: Sprint: Hold L3 / L2 / R2

Mobile: Sprint: Tap SprintButton

VR: Sprint: Press ButtonL1 (left controller)

Update: New map area, new morphs, new monster, and MORE!

Group: https://www.roblox.com/communities/8156679/X-Studio#!/about

Steel yourself and see if you have what it takes to survive in this horror...
